text:
Natalie: Heads-up — nightly perf alert: p95 generation latency for `small-gen` on north-cluster jumped +18% vs baseline around 02:10 UTC. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/alerts/xyz :rotating_light:
Sam: Noted. Spike aligns with the merge window. Latest merged PR was merge/ggl/batching-refactor (abc123).
Maya: CI perf-run flagged runtime_perf/select_kernel p95 breach too (test id: ci-perf-3001).
deploy-bot: Canary deployment canary-20260315-7 failed healthcheck in pool-gpu-1 at 02:14 UTC.
Kai: Ran a quick pprof on the failing canary. Top hotspots (samples):
```
cpu_samples: 1200
1. choose_kernel() 38%  <-- surprising
2. batch_builder::assemble 21%
3. kv_cache::evict_hotset 12%
```
Nate: choose_kernel() CPU share looks abnormal. abc123 changed scoring from windowed_score -> entropy_score and adjusted branch ordering.
Maya: Flamegraph attached: https://prof.redwood/fg/abc123 (shows deep in choose_kernel with many branching calls).
Sam: Starting a bisect on CI to isolate commit. Will run targeted perf-run across the merge range.
Sam: CI bisect results: the delta appears when abc123 is introduced; earlier commit def456 has a smaller bump but not the full p95. abc123 is the main regression.
Kai: I repro'd locally with modal seeds + small sequences. The regression is amplified when batch_builder coalesces short sequences across jobs — increases branching in choose_kernel and pushes more cache churn.
Maya: Quick local mitigation: force legacy scorer on short sequences. Patch snippet:
```
if (seq_len <= 64) {
  return legacy_score;
}
```
Nate: That reduces choose_kernel time by ~30% in my run and drops p95 back near baseline for small-gen.
Sam: I'll deploy a temporary rollback (revert abc123) to canary now.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by Sam. Target: canary-20260315-7 -> revert abc123. Status: in_progress.
Natalie: Placing rollout on hold until telemetry stabilizes. Notifying PMs: @pm-ops. :hand: Please keep the rollback scoped, we still want the non-regressive parts of the refactor.
Kai: Root cause summary: coalesce across sequences interacted poorly with new entropy-based kernel scoring; more candidates -> heavier choose_kernel path -> p95 latency increase and more frequent kv evictions for hot keys.
Maya: Filed PR with targeted fix that disables coalesce on the fast path and adds a kernel-selection fallback when branch depth > 8 -> PR #3421. Also added perf unit.
Sam: Rollback complete. Canary metrics now: p95 = +2% vs baseline, throughput stable. deploy-bot shows canary healthy.
deploy-bot: Rollback finished. canary-20260315-7: healthy, all checks passed.
Natalie: Good. Leaving rollout on hold until we validate the targeted fix in a staging perf job. Assigning follow-ups: postmortem ticket and ensure CI perf test includes a short-seq coalesce scenario.
Maya: I'll add the regression test to ci-perf and pin baseline. Also adding a small flamegraph capture to the nightly job.
Sam: Thanks all. Once staging perf passes we can merge PR #3421 and resume rollout. :thumbsup:
Natalie: Closing triage thread for now. Will update ticket with bisect log and links.
